tasks.build: NAME=$(git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD) && NAME=$(echo $NAME | sed 's/^v//;s/\./_/g') && deno compile -A --output bin/lq_$(echo $NAME)_win64.exe main.ts
tasks.build:all: NAME=$(git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD) && NAME=$(echo $NAME | sed 's/^v//;s/\./_/g') && deno compile -A --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output bin/lq_$(echo $NAME)_win64.exe main.ts && deno compile -A --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output bin/lq_$(echo $NAME)_mac main.ts && deno compile -A --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output bin/lq_$(echo $NAME)_linux main.ts
